## The claim

At least 80 percent of the 1,199 alleles the delivered callset never reported, which step 2's read-derived callers found and annotated, are confirmed at the same multiplicity by alignment-free k-mer genotyping.

**Prediction if true.** Of the 1,199 alleles in warehouse.it2_read_annotations that receive at least three usable probe pairs, at least 80 percent are called at the same genotype class the read callers assigned, at posterior >= 0.95.

**What would refute it.** Fewer than 80 percent are confirmed, in which case every biallelic count step 2 reported is revised downward and the read route gains a measured false-positive rate in place of a caveat.

## Evidence

Nothing observed yet. This claim is proposed, not tested.
